title: admin-panel shared definitions
description: Definitions referenced by admin-panel's audit.<action>.schema.json files. Not a message by itself.

rejection.description: Shared shape of every admin-panel rejection audit message. Published to ALL_AUDIT on admin-panel.audit.<action>.pub for a request whose admin JWT is valid but that admin-panel itself rejects before any downstream request (403 insufficient_admin_role, 400 invalid_request, 400 invalid_pagination). NATS headers: team = "admin", Nats-Msg-Id = "admin-panel-<publisher_seq>", request_id = the decimal request_id. The message carries no team_id field (team: admin record); a team the request names appears only as resource_id. It never carries a JWT, key material, secret or payload value.

publisher_seq.description: In-memory counter: starts at admin-panel's start time in Unix microseconds; each message takes max(previous + 1, now in Unix microseconds).

actor_subject.description: The verified admin JWT subject (external text).

resource_type.description: team for /admin/teams*, execution_tags for /admin/tags, tasks for /admin/tasks.

resource_id.description: The valid integer team_id the request names (path or team_id filter), or null.
